name: devflow
description: Stack-agnostic plan/build/verify/ship workflow. Detects each project's real toolchain at runtime instead of guessing, so lint, typecheck, and tests run correctly in any repo - Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java, or mixed. Adds auto-lint-on-edit hooks, a hang-guard for watch-mode commands, stack-aware review agents, and a cross-repo ticket flow.
